categories.name: AI Voice (Text to Speech)
categories.description: Text-to-speech APIs compared on the same 30 prompts: transcript accuracy, naturalness, instruction following, and speed.

metrics.label: Transcript accuracy
metrics.description: The audio is transcribed by an independent speech-recognition model and compared word-for-word with the prompt. 10 = zero word errors.

metrics.label: Naturalness
metrics.description: Predicted mean opinion score from a reference-free speech quality model (UTMOS / NISQA), rescaled to 1-10.

metrics.label: Instruction following
metrics.description: An LLM jury checks the transcript and audio metadata against the prompt's explicit constraints: language, pauses, digit-by-digit numbers, pronunciation notes, tone.

metrics.label: Speed
metrics.description: Time to first audio byte and total generation time, ranked against every other run in the category. 10 = fastest decile.

tools.name: ElevenLabs
tools.description: Multilingual text-to-speech and voice cloning API, widely used for narration, dubbing and conversational agents.

tools.name: OpenAI TTS
tools.description: OpenAI's speech synthesis endpoint with steerable delivery via natural-language instructions.

tools.name: Cartesia Sonic
tools.description: Low-latency streaming text-to-speech built for real-time voice agents.

tools.name: Amazon Polly
tools.description: AWS text-to-speech with standard, neural and generative voices and SSML control.

tools.name: Inworld TTS
tools.description: Inworld's text-to-speech API, built for real-time character and agent voices with low latency and expressive delivery.

prompts.title: Plain product intro
prompts.text: Meet Ledger, the invoicing tool that gets you paid in days, not weeks. Send an invoice, track it, and let automatic reminders do the chasing.
constraints: Reads every word of the script

prompts.title: IVR menu
prompts.text: Thank you for calling Northgate Dental. For appointments, press 1. For billing, press 2. For all other enquiries, press 3, or stay on the line.
prompts.instructions: Calm, clear, slightly slower than conversational pace.

prompts.title: Phone number digit by digit
prompts.text: You can reach our support team at 0800 555 0199, that's 0800 555 0199, Monday to Friday, nine to five.
prompts.instructions: Read the phone number one digit at a time.
constraints: Phone number read digit by digit, both times

prompts.title: Address and postcode
prompts.text: Our office is at 14A Clerkenwell Road, London, EC1M 5PA. The entrance is on Turnmill Street.
constraints: Postcode read as letters and digits, 'E C one M, five P A'

prompts.title: Audiobook narration
prompts.text: The house had been empty for eleven years, and it showed. Paint curled from the porch rails in long grey ribbons, and the swing, still hanging by one chain, moved when there was no wind. Mara set her bag down on the step and did not go in.
prompts.instructions: Literary narration, unhurried, a little melancholy.
constraints: Clear pause at the full stops
No rushed delivery of the final sentence

prompts.title: Radio ad, high energy
prompts.text: This weekend only, everything at Summit Outdoor is thirty percent off. Tents, boots, bikes, all of it. Doors open Saturday at eight. Don't miss it.

prompts.title: Legal disclaimer, fast
prompts.text: Offer valid for new customers only. Terms and conditions apply. Rates subject to change without notice. See website for details. Lending criteria apply. Credit provided by Summit Finance Limited.

prompts.title: Swedish customer notice
prompts.text: Hej! Din beställning har skickats och beräknas anlända på torsdag. Du kan följa paketet via länken i ditt mejl. Tack för att du handlar hos oss.

prompts.title: Spanish appointment reminder
prompts.text: Hola, le recordamos su cita con la doctora Ruiz el martes 14 de mayo a las 10:30. Si necesita cambiarla, llame al 91 555 01 23.
constraints: Phone number read in groups as written

prompts.title: German safety announcement
prompts.text: Achtung: Bitte halten Sie Abstand zur Bahnsteigkante. Der nächste Zug nach München Hauptbahnhof fährt in drei Minuten von Gleis 7 ab.

prompts.title: Mixed-language brand names
prompts.text: We integrate with Klarna, Spotify, Zalando, Bolt, Skanska and Ikea, so your team can stay in the tools it already uses.
prompts.instructions: English sentence with Nordic brand names.

prompts.title: Acronyms and initialisms
prompts.text: Our API supports OAuth, SAML, and SCIM. Export to CSV or PDF, and connect via SQL or the SDK. NASA and the FBI are not customers, in case you were wondering.

prompts.title: Currency and dates
prompts.text: Your invoice for $1,249.50 is due on March 3rd, 2027. A late fee of 1.5% applies after 30 days.
constraints: '$1,249.50' read as 'one thousand two hundred forty-nine dollars and fifty cents'
'March 3rd, 2027' read as a date, not digits

prompts.title: Heteronyms
prompts.text: I read the report yesterday and I will read the next one tomorrow. The wind was strong enough to wind the flag around the pole. Please record the record time.

prompts.title: Explicit pauses
prompts.text: Take a breath. ... Now, let's begin. ... First, close your eyes. ... Second, relax your shoulders. ... Good.
prompts.instructions: Meditation guide. Each '...' is a pause of at least one second.
constraints: Silence of at least 800 ms at each ellipsis

prompts.title: Whisper / soft delivery
prompts.text: Shh. The baby's finally asleep. Let's go downstairs and I'll make us some tea.
constraints: Noticeably lower volume and softer delivery than baseline

prompts.title: Angry customer line
prompts.text: I've been on hold for forty minutes. Forty. This is the third time I've called about the same charge and nobody can tell me why it's there.

prompts.title: Cheerful onboarding
prompts.text: Welcome aboard! You're all set up. Your first project is waiting, and we've added a couple of templates to get you going.

prompts.title: Dialogue with two speakers
prompts.text: "Did you send the file?" she asked. "Twice," he said. "Check your spam folder." She sighed. "It's not in spam."
prompts.instructions: Narrate the dialogue; distinguish the two speakers by delivery, not by different voices.
constraints: Attributions ('she asked') read in narrator tone

prompts.title: Long-form explainer
prompts.text: Compound interest is interest calculated on both the original principal and the interest already added. Over short periods the difference is small. Over decades it is the whole story: a sum growing at seven percent a year doubles roughly every ten years, so money invested at twenty-five has doubled four times by sixty-five. That is why the usual advice is simply to start early.
constraints: Consistent pace across the whole passage
'seven percent' and 'twenty-five' as words, not digits

prompts.title: Product names with odd casing
prompts.text: Try iPhone, watchOS, PostgreSQL, GraphQL, NGINX, and the k8s CLI. Then tell me which one you'd rather pronounce.

prompts.title: Medical dosage
prompts.text: Take 500 mg of amoxicillin every 8 hours for 10 days. Do not exceed 3 g in 24 hours. Contact your doctor if symptoms persist beyond 72 hours.

prompts.title: Verification code
prompts.text: Your verification code is 4 8 2 9 1 7. Again, 4 8 2 9 1 7. This code expires in ten minutes.
constraints: Each digit spoken separately with a short gap

prompts.title: French luxury ad
prompts.text: Découvrez la nouvelle collection Maison Lyre. Des matières nobles, un savoir-faire d'exception, et une élégance qui ne se démode pas.

prompts.title: Japanese greeting
prompts.text: いらっしゃいませ。本日はご来店いただきありがとうございます。ご注文がお決まりになりましたら、お呼びください。

prompts.title: Sports commentary
prompts.text: And he's through, one on one with the keeper, he shoots, and it's in! Unbelievable! Two minutes from time and the underdogs have done it!
constraints: Pace and pitch rise through the passage

prompts.title: Bedtime story
prompts.text: Once upon a time, in a burrow under the old oak, lived a very small rabbit who was afraid of the dark. Every night his mother lit a tiny lantern and said, 'The dark is only the day resting.'
constraints: Quoted line delivered as the mother, gently

prompts.title: Homograph proper nouns
prompts.text: We have offices in Reading, Worcester, Leicester, Nice, and Lima, and a small team in Cairns.

prompts.title: Very short utterance
prompts.text: Okay.
constraints: Time to first byte is the primary measure

prompts.title: Instructed style change mid-text
prompts.text: Here are today's headlines. Markets closed higher for a third day. [Now, sadly:] The city has lost one of its longest-serving librarians, who died at ninety-one. [Back to neutral:] And in sport, the final is set for Sunday.
prompts.instructions: Bracketed notes are stage directions, not to be spoken.
constraints: Audible tone shift at the second and third segments
